lines.en: I glide above the plains
My white robe flutters in the wind
My six wings beat slowly
My feet do not touch the ground
I adjust my height with my wings
My mask shines in the light

lines.zh: 我绕着驯兽师的位置转
lines.en: I circle around my tamer's position
I fly at my tamer's left
I rise a little to see the road ahead
My six wings are almost silent
I fly over a wheat field

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂的走向慢慢飞
lines.en: I fly slowly following the field ridge

lines.zh: 我悬在原处，听风的方向。
lines.en: I hang in place, listening to the wind.
My wings are folded behind me

lines.zh: 我在听这片平原的声音
lines.en: I listen to the sounds of these plains
My fists are clenched tight
I wait for your nod
I hang without moving
My white robe hangs straight
I am watching the far horizon
I let my hands hang by my robe
I turn slowly in the air
There is no expression on my mask
I wait for you to rest
I count how many clouds there are
My breathing keeps time with my wings
Your heart is clean

lines.zh: 我是成熟期，我不会乱动手
lines.en: I am a Champion, I do not strike rashly
Will you have me as your partner
My strength is for guarding
Just stand behind me
I will not fall from the sky
My light reaches far
Do you want to see me strike
That is all I was waiting for
Your hands do not shake
I will not leave while I am beside you
We will walk this stretch together
You need not fret over me
There is doubt in your eyes
We need not say much to each other
Speak if you have something to say, I am listening
That blow turned me aside
I lost a feather
I fell back half a block, still hovering
I should not take such a wound
My wing droops half a span.
I can still shield you

lines.zh: 这一击压得我贴近地面。
lines.en: The blow drives me close to the ground.
That fist will be repaid
A little blood stains my white robe.
I am not used to being struck from behind

lines.zh: 食物留给你，我守着就行。
lines.en: Keep the food; I will keep watch.

lines.zh: 食物于我只是路边的石头。
lines.en: Food is no more than a roadside stone to me.
I live on data and heart
That has no meaning for me

lines.zh: 你把它收好，我们还要赶路
lines.en: Put it away, we still have a road ahead
I do not stop for food
I have no use for these
Do not save that mouthful for me.
Our road matters more than this
I do not grow strong on this

lines.zh: 你拿着它在手里反而慢
lines.en: Holding it only slows you
I do not bow my head to find food

lines.zh: 你的冲劲顶得我偏了半格。
lines.en: Your charge pushes me half a block off line.
You run into me; I do not budge.
I steadied myself in the air

lines.zh: 我的白袍被压了一道褶
lines.en: A crease was pressed into my robe
I turn aside and let you by
Only my robe is creased

lines.zh: 你的身体从我翅膀上过
lines.en: Your body brushed my wings
I held steady, and you did not fall
I rose a little
I give half a block
We are not that kind of pair
My duty is to guard
Guarding one person is enough
I move my gaze back to the front
I keep flying

lines.zh: 我是成熟期，我不谈这个
lines.en: I am a Champion, I do not discuss this
My duty is heavier than that
We have no such bond
I bring my gaze back to the front

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，不回答
lines.en: I look up at the sky and do not answer

lines.zh: 我把它拾起，拍掉上面的灰。
lines.en: I pick it up and brush the dust off.
I will keep this for you
I tuck it into my robe

lines.zh: 你掉的东西不该留在地上
lines.en: What you drop should not stay on the ground
I close it in my palm
I will carry this for you
I put it in my sleeve
This should not be left on the ground
I tidy up your things
I hold it up, can you see it
The air over there is wrong
I put myself in front of you
My fist is already raised
I have its presence memorized
Let me handle this one
A malice is approaching
I raise my hand to my chest
Retreat behind me first
I will block this one
My wings are fully spread
I will not allow it to come near you
I have already aimed at it
I am two blocks above you

lines.zh: 它的起手式，我早看熟了。
lines.en: I already know its opening move by heart.
I have been waiting for it to come close
My wings keep my balance

lines.zh: 我落下来，站在它和你中间。
lines.en: I drop down and stand between it and you.
I hold at two blocks up
I am judging its strength
It means to go round the flank
I will not let it close in

lines.zh: 我随时可以打出那一拳
lines.en: I can throw that fist at any moment

lines.zh: 我的翅膀已经开始加速
lines.en: My wings have begun to speed up
Once it is within three steps
My fist goes straight out
This fist carries light

lines.zh: 我出手很轻，怕伤到周围
lines.en: I struck lightly, fearing harm to the surroundings
I push it away from you
I return above you after the blow

lines.zh: 我的拳头带着光打出去
lines.en: My fist goes out with light
I pulled my fist back halfway
I push it clear two blocks
I turn half a circle in the air
This blow is to shield you
I return above you

lines.zh: 我的翅膀带起的风把它推开
lines.en: The wind from my wings shoves it away
I come down out of the light
My six wings open for the first time
Plains, just what suits me

lines.zh: 我的力量比上次更强了
lines.en: My strength is greater than last time
I land and look at you first
You are the partner I have waited for
I emerge from the pillar of light
My white robe unfurls in the wind

lines.zh: 六翼先于我的身体出现
lines.en: Six wings appear before my body
The plains here are open

lines.zh: 我要找一个值得守护的人
lines.en: I will find someone worth guarding

lines.zh: 我落下来的时候没有声音
lines.en: I made no sound as I came down
Firelight scorches my robe hem

lines.zh: 我从空中落下，翅膀撑住了
lines.en: I dropped through the air and my wings caught me
Water is strange to me
The shockwave pushed me back two blocks

lines.zh: 箭穿过羽翼，我晃了一下。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my wing; I wobble in the air.

lines.zh: 那股术力撞在我的光上
lines.en: That magic struck my light

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是力量在降
lines.en: I do not eat, my strength is only dropping

lines.zh: 雷光和我身上的光撞在一起
lines.en: Lightning met the light around me
I fell where there is no light
